requirements.text: The project must compile using CMake to create the count_even executable without errors.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |

requirements.text: The program must validate CLI arguments, exiting with code 1 for wrong argument count and code 2 for invalid numbers, out-of-range values, or left > right, printing clear error messages to stderr.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |
| CLI validation | 1 | Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments |

requirements.text: The program must compute correct results for even integer counts across the inclusive interval [left, right], including zero and negative numbers.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |

requirements.text: On success, output must contain only one integer and a newline in stdout. On errors, stdout must be empty and errors directed to stderr.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |
| CLI validation | 1 | Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments |
| Output format | 1 | Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors |

criteria.title: Build
criteria.verification_method: Run cmake configuration and build commands and verify that count_even is generated without errors.

criteria.title: Correctness
criteria.description: Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values.
criteria.verification_method: Run the executable with various valid intervals (including negative numbers, zero, and single-value intervals) and verify correct counts.

criteria.title: CLI validation
criteria.description: Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments.
criteria.verification_method: Execute program with incorrect argument counts, out-of-range arguments, non-integers, and left > right, checking exit codes (1 or 2) and non-empty stderr.

criteria.title: Output format
criteria.description: Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors.
criteria.verification_method: Inspect standard output and standard error across successful and error test cases to verify exact formatting.
